field.name: description
field.p: Active sponsorships (S, SC, SWP), except those of the origin "unsponsored/surplus fund", where no letter from the child has reached the sponsor (state "Published to Global Partner") 3 months after the start date.
Keep the condition on the sponsorship state inside the letter condition: it does not change the result, but it keeps the query fast (about 0.1 s instead of about 10 s).

record.field: [("state", "=", "active"), ("type", "in", ["S", "SC", "SWP"]), ("origin_id", "not any", [("name", "=", "unsponsored/surplus fund")]), ("correspondence_ids", "not any", [("direction", "=", "Beneficiary To Supporter"), ("state", "=", "Published to Global Partner"), ("sponsorship_id.state", "=", "active")])]
